# Claim coverage map

Every claim made in the uploaded source pages, and where the theme's content answers it. The source pages are referred to by their own titles; the site itself never names the source website.

## "What is the Islamic Dilemma?" (main page)

| Claim | Answered in |
|---|---|
| If the Gospel is preserved, Islam is false; if corrupted, the Qur'an is false for affirming it | Muslim Response §1–5; Understanding the Islamic Dilemma |
| Q 29:46 commands Muslims to believe in the Bible; Muslims say the opposite | Enrichment: "We believe in what was revealed to you": Q 29:46 |
| Muslims call the Christian God a false god, against "our God and your God is one" | Same post, section "Our God and your God is one" |
| "The Bible agrees with itself 1,000 times" | Enrichment: Three contrasts, three misquotations ("The other errors on the same page") |
| Contrast 1: mediator (1 Tim 2:5 vs Q 4:171) | Three contrasts — notes the Arabic printed is Q 2:255, which affirms intercession by permission |
| Contrast 2: Tawhid vs Trinity (1 Cor 8:6 vs "Q 3:185") | Three contrasts — wrong English verse; 1 Cor 8:6 calls the one God "the Father" |
| Contrast 3: eternal life (John 3:16 vs Q 3:185) | Three contrasts — Q 3:185 itself promises Paradise; Hebrews 9:27 parallel |
| The Injil is not a separate book: "where is it, who quoted it?" | Enrichment: Where is the Injil?; Muslim Response §2 and §6 |
| "The Qur'an says it was a book in the hands of Christians in 700" | Where is the Injil? and Three contrasts (date error: the Prophet died in 632) |
| Q 3:3–4: if God revealed them as guidance, how could they be corrupted? | Muslim Response §4 (entrusted, not guarded); Every verse on the Gospel |
| Q 5:47: Christians commanded to judge by the Gospel | Enrichment: Judge by it, uphold it; Muslim Response §3 |
| Q 5:48 shows the Injil was a physical book held publicly | Enrichment: What does Qur'an 5:48 actually confirm? (the verse sends judgment to the Qur'an) |
| Q 18:27: none can change God's words, so the Bible can't be corrupt | Enrichment: "None can change His words" (Q 2:59, 2:75, 48:15 use the same vocabulary for people changing God's word) |
| Q 5:68: uphold the Torah and Gospel | Judge by it, uphold it (the verse includes the Qur'an and predicts rejection) |
| Q 10:94: Muhammad told to seek confirmation from the People of the Book | Enrichment: "Ask those who read the scripture before you": Q 10:94 |
| "Islam says you can get your own sins forgiven. That is a lie." | Page: Sin and repentance in Islam ("Only God forgives") |
| "The issue of the Qur'an is it resets who Jesus is" | Pages: An invitation to Christians; Paul and the message of Jesus |

## Not answered, deliberately

- The source pages' book promotion and links to other websites: not a claim; the site names no other websites by the owner's rule.
- The devotional lists of Bible verses about Christian identity, where they make no claim about Islam: Christians are free to describe their faith; only the contrasts drawn with Islam are answered.
